item.title: Vance says administration is pausing some Medicaid funding to Minnesota because of fraud concerns
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) – Vice President JD Vance announced Wednesday that the Trump administration would “temporarily halt” some Medicaid funding to the state of Minnesota over fraud concerns, as part of what he described as an aggressive crackdown on misuse of public funds. item.title: McCallie Holds Off Brentwood Academy 67-66 in State Tourney Opener
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) McCallie sweated out a 67-66 win over Brentwood Academy in their state tournament opener. Ryan Wingard and Garrison White each had 17 points for the Blue Tornado. McCallie played without leading scorer Ernas Valauskas, who was sidelined by an injury. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Heritage Falls in State Tournament
item.description: Ringgold, GA-(WDEF-TV) Heritage was trying to claim their first ever win in the state tournament on Wednesday, but the Generals fell short against Westside of Augusta falling 66-60. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
